name: @argentum/openapi-tools
description: Everything downstream of apps/backend/openapi/v1.yaml: the Postman collection, the Python SDK's types, a verdict on whether the document is valid OpenAPI 3.1, and the check that keeps the quickstart's code blocks equal to the files CI runs.

scripts.build: pnpm validate && pnpm postman && pnpm python-types && pnpm examples
scripts.check: pnpm validate && node scripts/gen-postman.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-python-types.mjs --check && pnpm examples
